unit.why: An ethical teaching on mercy, quoted from a book, frames one narrative: Elijah tests R. Eliezer, the Besht's father, and promises him a son.

stories.start_quote: וספרו מעשה נפלאה מרבי אליעזר אבי הבעש״ט
stories.summary_en: R. Eliezer, the Besht's father, is famed for hospitality, so Heaven decides to test him; Elijah comes disguised as a poor man who has broken the Sabbath, and R. Eliezer hosts him without shaming him, so Elijah reveals himself and promises a son who will enlighten Israel, the Besht.
